content_of_post_to_answer: How do you know when a stressful phase has become a chronic pattern?
answer: A stressful phase becomes a chronic pattern when stress stops feeling like an interruption and starts becoming the background setting of your life. The subtle shift is not just how much pressure you face, but whether your mind and body have forgotten what recovery feels like. Many people look for a dramatic breaking point, but chronic stress often appears through smaller signs: always anticipating the next problem, struggling to relax without guilt, or treating exhaustion as normal. The overlooked question is not only “How much stress am I under?” but “Has my life started organizing itself around being stressed?” A difficult season demands endurance; a chronic pattern quietly reshapes your identity.
